raw_resume.summary: B.Tech Computer Science and Engineering graduate (2025) who builds full-stack web applications with Java, Spring Boot and React. Seeking a Software Development Engineer role to apply expertise in scalable systems and object-oriented design.

projects.name: PaySplit - Group Expense Settlement
projects.description: Built a Spring Boot REST API and React TypeScript frontend to split shared expenses. Integrated Razorpay test-mode payments with webhooks for created, captured and refunded states. Wrote 40 JUnit tests and containerised the app with Docker.

projects.name: Campus Library Reservations
projects.description: Designed a Java and Spring Boot service with a MySQL schema for booking study rooms; piloted for 2 weeks with 120 students and eliminated double bookings.

projects.name: Order Tracker Dashboard
projects.description: Developed a React and TypeScript dashboard consuming a REST API to track order status, deployed locally with Docker Compose.

profile_improvement_tips: Gain hands-on experience with Data Structures and Algorithms through competitive programming or LeetCode; this is a core requirement for the role.
Study Distributed Systems concepts (consistency models, consensus algorithms, microservices patterns) and apply them in a project or internship.
Deepen Object-Oriented Design knowledge by refactoring your projects to showcase design patterns (Factory, Observer, Strategy) and SOLID principles in code.
Build or contribute to a project that demonstrates real-time systems or high-concurrency handling to align with the role's emphasis.
raw_resume.growth_note: You are a strong full-stack developer with solid project experience, but the JD emphasizes Data Structures, Algorithms, Distributed Systems, and Object-Oriented Design—none of which are evident in your current profile. Gaining these fundamentals before applying will significantly improve your fit.
